Vendored crates — provenance & maintenance
==========================================

Unlike `third_party/` (vendored C/C++ compiled into one of our own crates), this
directory holds whole upstream *Rust* crates used as path dependencies. They are
pinned checkouts, updated by hand — there is no registry version to bump.

Each is `exclude`d in the root `Cargo.toml`. That is not cosmetic: cargo makes any
path dependency inside the workspace directory a member automatically, which puts it
under `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` and fails the lint on upstream's own
style. Cargo only caps lints for crates it did not consider local, and `--exclude` on
the command line does not change that; declaring it excluded in the manifest does.
The crate still builds exactly as before, as a path dependency.

sokol-rust
----------
https://github.com/floooh/sokol-rust — Rust bindings to the sokol headers, and the
sokol C sources themselves (`src/sokol/c/`), compiled by its own build.rs.
Pinned commit: b22a545
License: zlib/libpng (see sokol-rust/LICENSE).
Not on crates.io under this name — the `sokol` name there belongs to an unrelated
2019 crate — which is why it is vendored rather than depended on by version.

`sokol_gfx` is the one drawing API the renderer targets on both Windows and macOS
(D3D11 and Metal underneath); see `mac-port-plan.md` §1 and D21. Updating the pin
means replacing the tree wholesale and re-checking the `sg_swapchain` / `ShaderDesc`
shapes the renderer builds by hand.

One local modification, and only one: `sokol-rust/rustfmt.toml` gains
`disable_all_formatting = true`. `cargo fmt --all` follows path dependencies, so it
reaches this tree even though the workspace `exclude`s it — the exclude keeps it out
of the build and lint graph, not out of fmt — and reformats upstream's code to a
style that is neither theirs nor ours, turning every touched line into a conflict at
the next pin bump. rustfmt reads the nearest rustfmt.toml above each file, so that is
the one place the switch works; the stable `ignore` option is nightly-only. Drop the
line when re-vendoring, then add it back.
